finding: A dedicated @helixui/drupal-starter package exists with module file, libraries.yml, SDC components, Twig templates, and Drupal behaviors — zero coupling to any JS framework required.
helixui.module calls attach_library('helixui/hx-core') but the library is defined as 'helixui/core' in helixui.libraries.yml — this will produce a Drupal fatal error on every page load.
recommendation: Change line 27 of helixui.module from 'helixui/hx-core' to 'helixui/core' to match the library key defined in helixui.libraries.yml.

finding: helixui.info.yml declares core_version_requirement of '^10.1 || ^11.0' with a dependency on drupal:sdc, correctly scoping the module to SDC-capable Drupal versions.
The module declares status 'experimental' in helixui.info.yml, which triggers a Drupal admin warning and can block enterprise clients with module stability policies from enabling it.
recommendation: Promote module lifecycle status to 'stable' once integration tests pass and the library reaches 3.0.0 stable release.

finding: hook_library_info_alter() in helixui.module correctly rewrites all local /libraries/helixui/ paths to CDN URLs when HELIXUI_CDN_URL is configured, enabling zero-config CDN switching without touching template files.

hook_page_attachments_alter() contains all route-conditional examples commented out, meaning developers copy-pasting the module get no working per-route asset loading without manual un-commenting and customization.
recommendation: Provide at least one active default example (e.g., loading helixui/core on non-admin routes) so new integrators have a working starting point, with others commented as extension examples.

finding: Drupal's native #states API does not detect changes on web component custom events (hx-change) — only native change/input events on standard form elements — leaving conditional field patterns requiring a custom behavior workaround that site builders may not discover.
recommendation: Add a dedicated 'drupal-states-compatibility' note to the forms documentation and ensure helixuiConditionalFields behavior is prominently featured as the required replacement for #states when using HELiX form components.

finding: hx-button participates in native HTML form submission via ElementInternals (formAssociated = true), meaning standard Drupal form API forms submit correctly without JavaScript glue code.
hx-select accepts slotted native <option> and <optgroup> elements in the light DOM, making it compatible with Drupal Form API #options rendering without modification.
hx-text-input Twig template correctly maps Drupal Form API element properties (element['#name'], element['#title'], element['#required'], element['#errors']) to web component attributes.

The CDN build artifacts (dist/cdn/) do not exist in the repository — the build:cdn script exists but has never been run, meaning the CDN integration path documented in INTEGRATION.md is not ship-ready.
recommendation: Run 'pnpm --filter @helixui/library run build:cdn' and either commit the artifacts to a release asset or add it to the CI release pipeline so CDN artifacts are produced and published with every release.

finding: The CDN libraries.yml template correctly uses attributes: { type: module } for all script entries and type: external to prevent Drupal's aggregation system from attempting to process CDN-hosted ES modules.

The CDN template only covers 12 components (button, card, text-input, alert, dialog, badge, spinner, tooltip, tabs, select, checkbox, status-indicator) while the local libraries.yml covers all 75+ components — CDN adopters of other components have no documented path.
recommendation: Either extend the CDN template to cover all components, or add a generator script similar to generate:drupal-libraries that produces the full CDN template from the component manifest.

finding: The CDN template documents a per-component split bundle strategy but does not include a helix-core library entry for the shared Lit runtime chunk — the build-cdn.mjs script produces helix-core-{version}.min.js that must load before per-component files.
recommendation: Add a helix-core library entry to the CDN template and document the required loading order: attach helix_cdn/helix-core before any per-component library to avoid Lit loading multiple times.

finding: No Subresource Integrity (SRI) hash support is documented or provided for the CDN loading strategy — enterprise healthcare clients subject to HIPAA and security audits will require SRI hashes on all third-party assets.
recommendation: Add SRI hash generation to the build-cdn.mjs script, output hashes to manifest.json, and document how to add integrity: and crossorigin: attributes to Drupal library entries.

finding: The INTEGRATION.md CDN guide is comprehensive — covers file placement, library YAML configuration, Twig attach_library usage, preprocess hooks, AdvAgg compatibility, CSP configuration, CORS, and version upgrade procedures.

The local npm strategy in helixui.libraries.yml is well-structured with a 'core' base library, per-component libraries with correct dependency declarations (e.g., hx-button-group depends on helixui/hx-button), and an 'all' aggregate library.
Standalone Twig templates exist for hx-button, hx-card, hx-text-input, and hx-form with correct Drupal docblock format, attach_library calls, and comprehensive available variables documentation.

Standalone Twig templates only cover 4 components (hx-button, hx-card, hx-text-input, hx-form) while 59 SDC wrappers exist — high-demand form components like hx-select, hx-checkbox, hx-textarea, hx-radio-group, and hx-dialog have no standalone templates.
recommendation: Generate standalone templates for the remaining form components (hx-select, hx-checkbox, hx-radio-group, hx-textarea, hx-dialog, hx-alert, hx-date-picker) as these are the most commonly overridden Drupal form elements.

finding: hx-card Twig template correctly uses slot projection with slot='image', slot='heading', and slot='footer', with conditional attach_library calls for hx-image only when image_url is provided — optimal for performance.
hx-form template correctly passes Drupal CSRF tokens (form_id, form_build_id, form_token) as hidden inputs, which is required for Drupal form submission security.

hx-button Twig template uses slot='prefix' and slot='suffix' for icons but the standalone template passes them through hx-icon, while the SDC twig wraps them in a bare <span> — inconsistent slot wrapping between the two template styles may cause unexpected styling.
recommendation: Standardize slot wrapping: use <span slot='prefix'> in both the standalone template and SDC, removing the hx-icon intermediate wrapper from the standalone template, or document the intentional difference.

finding: All Drupal behaviors use the once() pattern with correct IIFE closure (Drupal, once) and implement both attach and detach methods where cleanup is needed — fully compatible with Layout Builder, AJAX, and BigPipe.

The @helixui/drupal-behaviors package provides 8 per-component behavior files (accordion, dialog, drawer, menu, popover, tabs, toast, tooltip) with selective loading support in libraries.yml — allows surgical behavior attachment.

helixuiSearchForm behavior adds a global document keydown listener inside the once() callback — if the SDC is destroyed and re-rendered via AJAX, the once() key prevents re-attachment but the previous listener is not removed in detach(), creating a ghost listener leak.
recommendation: Store the keydown handler reference on the element and remove it in the detach callback via once.remove() to prevent listener accumulation on AJAX-heavy pages.

finding: helixuiFormValidation uses a fuzzy label-matching heuristic to map Drupal error messages to HELiX inputs — this will fail when the Drupal error message does not contain the exact field label text, which is common with custom validator messages.
recommendation: Add a data-drupal-selector attribute strategy as the primary matching mechanism (input.getAttribute('data-drupal-selector') === errorItem.dataset.for) with the label heuristic as a fallback.

finding: helixuiFormAjax correctly bridges hx-change CustomEvents from web components to hidden native inputs for Drupal AJAX form rebuild compatibility, using the data-drupal-selector attribute as the registration key.

There is no Drupal behavior provided for hx-dialog AJAX compatibility — Drupal's AJAX system can trigger dialog opens via ajax_command_open_dialog but has no documented bridge to hx-dialog's open property.
recommendation: Add a helixuiDialogAjax behavior that listens for Drupal's ajaxDialogBeforeCreate event and routes it to the corresponding hx-dialog open property, with documentation on replacing core dialog.ajax with hx-dialog.

finding: hx-button SDC declares a complete .component.yml with $schema URL, typed props, enum constraints, slots (default, prefix, suffix), and Drupal-compatible YAML structure.

hx-button SDC component.yml lists 'success' and 'link' as valid variant enum values, but the actual hx-button component TypeScript source defines variants as primary|secondary|tertiary|danger|ghost|outline — 'success' and 'link' are not valid and will silently fail or trigger a devWarn.
recommendation: Update hx-button.component.yml variant enum to exactly match the component source: ['primary', 'secondary', 'tertiary', 'danger', 'ghost', 'outline'] — remove 'success' and 'link'.

finding: 59 SDC components exist spanning composition patterns (article-teaser, provider-card, hero-banner) and primitive wrappers (hx-text-input, hx-select, etc.) — comprehensive coverage for a Drupal 10/11 content architecture.

The helix-sdc.manifest.yml documents SDC-to-component mappings but views-grid lists an empty dependency array [] despite being a composition SDC — this breaks impact analysis when hx-card or other components change.
recommendation: Update helix-sdc.manifest.yml views-grid entry to accurately document the HELiX components it composes, even if only CSS custom properties are used.

finding: SDC .component.yml files use the official Drupal schema URL (git.drupalcode.org) which ensures Drupal's JSON schema validator will correctly validate prop types in Layout Builder and XB field mapping.

hx-patient-banner SDC correctly documents the Joint Commission NPSG.01.01.01 two-identifier rule requirement in its Twig template comments, with an example showing hx-phi-field composition for HIPAA-compliant masked display.

The Custom Elements Manifest (custom-elements.json, 28,019 lines) comprehensively documents all attribute names, types, defaults, and reflects:true properties — Drupal Twig templates can be written from the CEM without reading source code.

hx-button uses 'hx-size' as the HTML attribute name (not 'size') due to attribute mapping — the SDC correctly uses hx_size as the Twig prop and maps to hx-size attribute, but this non-standard naming is a discoverable stumbling block for Drupal developers writing direct markup.
recommendation: Prominently document the hx-size attribute naming in the Drupal integration guide and include a common mistakes section that shows incorrect 'size=' usage alongside correct 'hx-size=' usage.

finding: All boolean attributes (disabled, required, loading, readonly) reflect to HTML attributes via Lit's reflect: true, meaning Twig can set them as boolean HTML attributes without JavaScript — compatible with server-rendered HTML.

The Twig template for hx-text-input uses 'help-text' as the attribute name (line 57) but CEM and component source use 'helpText' as the property name with attribute 'help-text' — this is correct, but there is no validation that templates stay in sync with CEM attribute names when the component API changes.
recommendation: Add a CI check that parses all Twig templates for attribute names and validates them against the CEM to catch drift between template attribute usage and the actual component API.

finding: document-token-adoption.ts correctly guards all document and CSSStyleSheet access with typeof document !== 'undefined' and typeof CSSStyleSheet.prototype.replaceSync checks, making token adoption SSR-safe.
hx-carousel guards window.matchMedia access inside connectedCallback with a 'typeof window !== undefined' check, meaning it does not crash in SSR or when JS is deferred.
hx-theme guards all three window.matchMedia access points with typeof window !== 'undefined' checks in both property getters and private methods — fully SSR-safe.

No Lit Declarative Shadow DOM (DSD) support is implemented or documented — components only hydrate client-side, meaning content within Shadow DOM is invisible to Drupal's render cache keying and to search engines until JS loads.
recommendation: Evaluate Lit's server-side rendering package (@lit-labs/ssr) and DSD support for high-SEO content components (hx-card, hx-text, hx-breadcrumb). At minimum, document the SSR gap explicitly in the Drupal integration guide so teams understand the SEO implications.

finding: The drupal-starter README states 'Content rendered in Twig is visible in the HTML before JavaScript loads' but this only applies to slotted light DOM content — content rendered inside Shadow DOM (component internals) is not accessible until JS hydrates.
recommendation: Clarify the progressive enhancement documentation to distinguish between slotted content (pre-JS accessible) and internal component chrome (requires JS) to set accurate expectations for SEO and accessibility audits.

finding: Slot-based content composition is used throughout all Twig templates — heading text, body content, and links are rendered as light DOM children that are accessible before JavaScript loads.

hx-form template includes fallback hidden inputs for Drupal CSRF tokens, but the form will not submit correctly without JavaScript because hx-button (type=submit) relies on ElementInternals form association which requires JS — non-JS users cannot submit forms using HELiX form components.
recommendation: Document the no-JS form submission gap in the integration guide and recommend wrapping each hx-form with a <noscript> block that provides a native HTML form alternative for the no-JS path.

finding: Interactive components (hx-dialog, hx-drawer, hx-tabs) have no documented fallback behavior for the JavaScript-loading window — a tab panel shows all content simultaneously until JS upgrades the element, which can cause layout shifts (CLS) impacting Core Web Vitals.
recommendation: Add :not(:defined) CSS rules to helix-theme-overrides.css that hide only the chrome of interactive components while keeping their slotted content visible and accessible before JS loads.

finding: All ES module scripts correctly load with type: module which defers execution by default, ensuring scripts never block First Contentful Paint — correct loading strategy for progressive enhancement.

hx-phi-field renders PHI data as masked by default, but the masked state is controlled entirely via Shadow DOM internals — without JavaScript, the raw PHI value passed via the 'data' attribute is present in the DOM as a plain attribute value, readable by automated tools that inspect attributes.
recommendation: Evaluate whether the PHI data attribute should be omitted from server-rendered HTML and injected only after JS verification, or whether a server-side masking approach should be documented as required for HIPAA compliance in Drupal's render pipeline.

finding: The CKEditor 5 GHS configuration is documented in the drupal-starter README with specific hx-* tag allowlists, addressing the requirement for WYSIWYG authors to embed web components in body content.

No field formatter plugin (FieldFormatterInterface implementation) is provided or documented for rendering Drupal entity fields directly as HELiX web components — teams must write their own formatters or use View templates.
recommendation: Provide at least one example field formatter PHP class (e.g., WcCardFormatter for node bundles) in the drupal-starter package or documentation to give enterprise teams a starting pattern for entity-level integration.

finding: No Layout Builder block plugin is provided or documented — SDC components can be placed via SDC blocks in Layout Builder, but there is no documentation on how to expose HELiX SDCs as configurable Layout Builder blocks with an edit form.
recommendation: Add a Layout Builder integration guide to the drupal-integration docs section documenting how to expose SDCs as Layout Builder blocks and configure their props through the UI.

finding: The drupal-starter package version is 2.0.0 but uses peerDependency '@helixui/library': 'workspace:^' — this workspace protocol is only valid inside the monorepo and will fail when a Drupal team installs @helixui/drupal-starter from npm.
recommendation: Change the peerDependency to a semver range (e.g., '^1.0.0' or '^3.0.0' for the 3.0 release) and verify the package.json is correct before the 3.0 npm publish.

finding: The drupal-behaviors package provides 8 individual behavior files for interactive components with per-component selective loading, allowing themes to load only the behaviors they need — optimal for performance.

The Drupal integration documentation in apps/docs is comprehensive with dedicated directories for ajax, behaviors, blocks, ckeditor, forms, installation, migration, paragraphs, performance, sdc, security, theming, troubleshooting, twig, and views.

The CDN INTEGRATION.md uses 'variant="destructive"' in a Twig example but the actual hx-button component does not define a 'destructive' variant — valid values are primary, secondary, tertiary, danger, ghost, outline — this will silently clamp to 'primary' in production.
recommendation: Fix the CDN INTEGRATION.md example to use variant="danger" instead of variant="destructive" and audit all documentation examples for attribute value accuracy against the CEM.

finding: The document-token-adoption utility adopts tokens into the top-level document only — components rendered inside Drupal iframes (CKEditor 5 editor iframe, Layout Builder preview iframes) will not receive design tokens and will render with no styling.
recommendation: Document this limitation prominently and provide an ensureDocumentTokens() call pattern for CKEditor 5 and any iframe-embedded contexts, with a code example for the editor.js configuration.

finding: The libraries.yml correctly marks all dist JS files as { minified: true } which prevents Drupal's aggregation from double-minifying, and per-component libraries correctly declare helixui/core as a dependency ensuring token CSS and runtime load first.

The @helixui/drupal-behaviors package (v2.0.0) is a separate npm installable package, cleanly decoupled from drupal-starter, allowing themes that do not use the starter kit to still consume standardized behaviors.
